work_unit: Browser sign-out wired to durable JWT session revocation

assessment.reason: A browser sign-out must not claim success until the server has revoked the specific durable session.

dispatch.model: inherited session model (the follow-up tool does not expose the exact worker model)

execution.coordinator_review: Inspected the client-to-route contract and preserved pre-existing dirty frontend work outside the logout wiring.

behavior: The client sends the in-memory bearer token to POST /api/auth/logout and accepts only HTTP 204.
A confirmed logout, or a 401 from an already-expired/revoked session, clears the browser session.
Network and server failures retain the browser session and show a generic retryable error.
Duplicate sign-out requests are disabled while a request is pending.
validation: Coordinator inspection of the FastAPI logout route and durable AuthService session-revocation contract.
Next route type generation and TypeScript passed.
limitations: The local bootstrap account is assessment-only; it is not public registration or account recovery.
A live sign-in/sign-out browser check requires locally configured bootstrap credentials and hybrid or jwt mode.
